scope: Source graph with original actions; does not change rules. Detailed fixed event schedules initially Fireball only.
notes: Action arrays in a state run in original index order; ordinary states are parallel.
SpellFinishAction delays callback only, then immediately Finish()s the action. It does not delay the FSM transition.
An explicit FINISHED event from a timed action can transition while everyFrame actions remain active.
Death is a spell visual lifecycle state, not necessarily a game entity death.
Callers must not treat source-derived-complete event schedule as proof all renderer/shader actions are implemented.
Schedules with random_gates must sample once per source gate and share the draw across sibling layers, separately from game-rule RNG. A null at is an interval, never a zero delay.
